words.meaning: Someone Jesus chose and sent out with His authority to tell people about Him and to start and lead churches.
Wrong things a person does by stepping over the line God has drawn. It is close in meaning to sins.
Here it means lived or behaved, as a habit. To walk in sins is to make them your everyday way of life.

words.word: ruler of the power of the air
words.meaning: A title for the devil, Satan, who leads the evil spiritual forces working unseen in the world.
People whose lives are marked by refusing to obey God. Calling them "sons" of it means it shapes who they are.
Here it does not mean skin and muscle. It means human nature turned away from God, which pulls a person toward sin.
Giving in to something you want instead of holding back.
People who, because of the sinful nature they are born with, stand under God's holy anger against sin and deserve His judgment.
Kindness that holds back the punishment someone deserves and helps them instead.
God's favor and kindness given freely to people who have not earned it and could never earn it.
Rescued by God from sin and from the punishment it brings, and brought into new life with Him.
The unseen world of heaven, where God is and where Christ reigns, as opposed to the earthly world we see.
Going far beyond, greater than anything it could be measured against.
Trusting in God and relying on Christ, not on yourself, to be made right with Him.
Things a person does; deeds. Here, the good things people might do hoping to earn God's approval.
To brag, or to take pride in something as though you earned it yourself.
Something carefully made by a skilled maker. Paul means God crafted us on purpose, like a work of art.
